notes.title: Hotfix - Achievements should work again
notes.notes:
The past two days, Achievements have not been working as intended
You should get most of your Achievements retroactively

Sorry for the inconvenience!!

notes.title: New language and a bug fix
notes.notes:
Hello!

With this update we want to introduce Ukrainian as a new language to the game.
Shout out to darwinwasright & spicy ginger for their work and effort!

Also thanks to the community who made us aware of a bug related to the "Level Skip" button.

Have a great day! :))
